answer_1.quote: We introduce the task of text to complex statistical infographic generation... Infogen uses a two-stage process of metadata and code generation to convert unstructured text into well-aligned, multi-subchart infographics.

answer_2.quote: We introduce the following measures for evaluating the text-to-metadata generation task: (a) Sub-chart Accuracy... (b) Sub-chart Type Accuracy... (c) Statistical Accuracy... (d) Textual Information Metrics: Rouge-L scores for titles, summaries, and sub-chart-level summaries.

answer_3.quote: You are a judge LLM with expertise in evaluating Python code and graphical visualizations. Your task is to assess the provided Python code against the metadata.

answer_4.quote: A team of annotators who have knowledge of statistical infographics conducted a human evaluation on 35% of test samples... The evaluation metrics used: Readability Score, Visual Score, Data Accuracy and Alignment Score.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each infographic on Readability Score, Visual Score, and Data Accuracy and Alignment Score on a 1-5 scale.
